notes: The CONCRETE ARTIFACTS directive forces concrete file/symbol references in steps. On danluu post-mortems and operational-rollout cases that need high-level stakeholder coordination this produces worse plans. The cycle-4 +17pp gain on n=6 eval slice was eval-slice bias (incumbent unluckily underperformed at 83%); the n=6 holdout's 'weak generalisation' verdict (+0.028 composite) was underpowered noise. N=30 is the right granularity to gate prompt changes. Lesson: GEPA cycles must validate at N=30 (or at least N=20) before claiming a win, not n=6 where ceiling effects + variance dominate. Updated gepa_optimizer's default --holdout-n recommendation to 20 in the calibration record (no code change until next cycle so existing flags don't break).

notes: First feature-side GEPA cycle. Demonstrates the validation layer doing its job: an eval-slice composite gain that was actually orthogonal to the targeted failure mode, caught and rejected by holdout. Mirrors the rollout cycle-4 lesson (eval-slice bias from a single n=20 cohort) at the gate, not in retrospect. Implication for next cycle: launch_strategy_mismatch is genuinely hard. The reflector's diagnosis was right but its candidate prompts didn't fix it. Options: (1) richer per-feature-kind grounding in sequencer prompts, (2) bake strategy-decision rules into the JSON schema as a separate field with required reasoning, (3) collect more diverse mismatch traces (n=14 may be too few for a reliable diagnosis). The cycle architecture works correctly even when no winner is found — that's the right shape for autonomous improvement.

verdict.label: APPLIED — holdout confirms target gain, eval-only regression rejected
verdict.reason: Schema-level fix after the GEPA prompt-mutation cycle 1 was rejected at holdout. Eval (n=12 seed 1337): strat_ok 83% -> 92% (+8pp), judge caught 50% -> 25% (-25pp suspect noise), family 50% -> 58%. Holdout (n=12 seed 9256, disjoint): strat_ok 67% -> 83% (+17pp REPRODUCED AND BIGGER), judge caught 33% -> 33% (eval regression NOT REPRODUCED), family 67% -> 58% (improvement). Per cycle-4-encoded decision rule (apply iff target lift holds AND caught regression doesn't reproduce on holdout): both conditions met. robust_launch wins now visible in both slices (3+3 of 24 with reasoning, vs 0+0 without).

notes: DIFFERENT outcome shape from cycle 1: that cycle's eval winner was rejected at holdout (eval gain was illusory). This cycle's eval gain (target metric) was real AND its eval regression (judge caught) was the noise. The holdout step distinguished the two — exactly what it's for. Mechanism that worked: forcing the LLM to write strategy_reasoning BEFORE picking a strategy, plus heuristic anchors in BASE_TAIL (regulated -> full_release; mobile UX -> beta_program; etc.). This is the 'show your work' pattern. Opt-out preserved via MIROFISH_FEATURE_STRATEGY_REASONING=0 for back-compat with pre-cycle artifacts (FEATURE_BASELINE_N50 etc.). Suggested next: re-run N=48 baseline with reasoning ON to see if the +12pp avg strat_ok lift translates to a meaningful judge caught_rate gain at higher n (currently both slices are too small to detect <20pp deltas on caught_rate).

applied_path: mirofish_lab/feature_planning.py (default _strategy_reasoning_enabled() = False; opt-in via env var only)
notes: Second cycle-4-pattern failure caught at scale. The n=12 eval + n=12 holdout from cycle 2 showed +8pp eval / +17pp holdout strat_ok lift with the eval-only judge caught regression rejected by holdout (0pp there). At N=48 ALL of those signals invert: strat_ok regresses, judge caught and useful collapse, plans break. The n=24 holdout was insufficient sample power to detect proportions Δ <20pp. DISCIPLINE LESSON ENCODED: any change that gets persisted to defaults requires n>=30 per-side validation. n=12+12 is exploratory only. Updating the feature_gepa warning threshold to match the rollout cycle-4 lesson (rollout already has n=20 warning; bumping the FEATURE pipeline to n=30 floor since features have wider variance from the LLM having more freedom in step shape). MECHANISM POST-MORTEM: forcing a strategy_reasoning field eats output tokens (prompt grew from 2253 to 3518 chars), the LLM tries to fit reasoning into every step, action/success_criterion text gets terser, the judge marks them down. The 'show your work' pattern doesn't always win — when the model is already strained by output budget the cost can dominate the reasoning benefit. Two cycles, two opposite verdicts at small n; both turned out to be REJECT at scale. The validation discipline caught both — one at holdout (cycle 1), one at N=48 (this one). Process working as designed even when individual cycles fail.
